events.title: Black Friday discounts abound!
events.summary: Black Friday, while not technically a holiday, is considered by many to be the unofficial official kickoff to the holiday shopping season, and developers are running discounts on games on of all kinds between now and November 30th. That's why even though Steam isn't running an official Black Friday fest, we are dressing up our Discounts & Events page for it! We're also excited because it's the perfect time to share the updates we've been working on to make the Discounts & Events page a better experience altogether.

events.summary: Nominations are now open for the 2026 Steam Awards! From now through November 30th at 10 a.m. Pacific, you can nominate your favorite games of the year across several categories.
